title: OmniVia Core Application Contract v1 - decision payloads
description: Input and result payloads for the Decision Runtime application operations (ADR-042 / SPEC-CORE-DEC-001). The Decision Runtime makes bounded, evidence-bearing advisory assessments over authorised business context through provider-neutral contracts; a prediction is never an action grant, a permission, or canonical knowledge. All payloads are data-only: identifiers, bounded text and structured constraints. Raw filesystem paths, executable expressions, model-file URLs, credentials and tool names are not valid anywhere in this boundary. Evaluation is privacy-fenced by the caller's own constraints, which the server may narrow but never widen.

DecisionSchemaVersion.title: DecisionSchemaVersion
DecisionSchemaVersion.description: The payload schema version for every decision payload in this boundary. Independent of the application envelope and workspace format versions.

DecisionSubjectRef.title: DecisionSubjectRef
DecisionSubjectRef.description: One subject the evaluation is about: an opaque identifier minted by the owning feature, and the revision the caller last observed. The runtime resolves the reference through the owner; the string itself carries no path or storage meaning.

revision.description: The subject revision the caller last observed, as an opaque token.

DecisionExecutionMode.title: DecisionExecutionMode
DecisionExecutionMode.description: How the caller intends to use the result. `advisory` is the only mode in this release: the assessment is evidence for a human or an authorised executor, never an executed action. Later modes are separately qualified catalogue changes.

DecisionPrivacyFloor.title: DecisionPrivacyFloor
DecisionPrivacyFloor.description: The most permissive processing location the caller accepts. `local_only` binds every attempt to the selected Core host; the server may narrow but never widen this.

DecisionExecutionConstraints.title: DecisionExecutionConstraints
DecisionExecutionConstraints.description: Caller constraints on one evaluation. Policy composes these with installation, workspace and definition limits using the most restrictive effective result; a caller cannot elevate an unqualified template or escape a local-only floor.

mode.description: DecisionExecutionMode — How the caller intends to use the result. `advisory` is the only mode in this release: the assessment is evidence for a human or an authorised executor, never an executed action. Later modes are separately qualified catalogue changes.

privacy.description: DecisionPrivacyFloor — The most permissive processing location the caller accepts. `local_only` binds every attempt to the selected Core host; the server may narrow but never widen this.

deadline_ms.description: Requested wall-clock budget for the whole evaluation, including queue wait. Policy may permit longer job deadlines; it may never shorten past the minimum the definition requires.

maximum_provider_attempts.description: Maximum provider attempts. One is the default and the release maximum; a single transient-failure retry is a separately enabled policy.

DecisionDefinitionRef.title: DecisionDefinitionRef
DecisionDefinitionRef.description: An immutable Decision Definition version. Definitions are immutable; a semantic change to question, rubric, options or recipe is a new version.

version.description: Semantic version of the definition, such as `1.0.0`.

DecisionEvaluateInput.title: DecisionEvaluateInput
DecisionEvaluateInput.description: Input for `decision.evaluate`: one bounded, evidence-bearing assessment request. Identity, effective authority, scopes and purpose come from the authorised request envelope, never from these fields. The envelope's `idempotency_key` (required by the catalogue) is bound to the canonical request digest; reuse with a different request is an explicit conflict. Evaluation has durable side effects - it reads authorised sources and writes evaluation, attempt and audit records - even though it never mutates business records.

schema_version.description: DecisionSchemaVersion — The payload schema version for every decision payload in this boundary. Independent of the application envelope and workspace format versions.

definition_ref.description: DecisionDefinitionRef — An immutable Decision Definition version. Definitions are immutable; a semantic change to question, rubric, options or recipe is a new version.

subject_refs.description: The subjects this evaluation is about.

input.description: Authorised evidence inputs, resolved after admission.

execution.description: DecisionExecutionConstraints — Caller constraints on one evaluation. Policy composes these with installation, workspace and definition limits using the most restrictive effective result; a caller cannot elevate an unqualified template or escape a local-only floor.

DecisionPrediction.title: DecisionPrediction
DecisionPrediction.description: One typed prediction with its full provider distribution. `kind` selects which fields are meaningful; boolean, choice and ordinal semantics are distinct and must not share a generic acceptance threshold. `probability_semantics` names what the numbers are; `provider_decimal_precision` records the provider's own rounding so boundary-uncertainty abstention is possible.

selected_option_id.description: For choice: the highest-probability declared option. For ordinal: the highest-probability rubric category.

probabilities.description: Full returned distribution over the declared answer space, at provider precision.

probability_true.description: For boolean: the provider's probability of true. False is its complement; a false result is not a failure.

expected_index.description: For ordinal: the expected zero-based rubric index. A rubric position, never an event probability.

normalised_position.description: For ordinal: expected_index / (K - 1), labelled as a rubric position only.

probability_semantics.description: What the distribution numbers mean, such as `model_class_probability`.

provider_decimal_precision.description: Decimal places the provider itself returns.

DecisionQuality.title: DecisionQuality
DecisionQuality.description: Quality and qualification facts, kept strictly separate from the prediction and from authority. `empirical_correctness_probability` stays null until a held-out task-specific calibration exists; `calibration_status` is `unvalidated_for_task` for every first-release evaluation.

empirical_correctness_probability.description: Held-out task-specific estimate, or null while unsupported.

input_complete.description: Whether the loss-aware preflight admitted the context without any unapproved loss.

qualification_ref.description: Opaque reference to the applicable qualification profile, or null.

DecisionDisposition.title: DecisionDisposition
DecisionDisposition.description: The deterministic policy result governing how this prediction may be used. `authorises_action` is false for every first-release evaluation; it can never be inferred from any probability, confidence or action-head field.

reason_codes.description: Bounded reason codes from the canonical decision reason catalogue, such as `TASK_NOT_QUALIFIED_FOR_AUTOMATION` or `INPUT_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED`.

authorises_action.description: Constant false in this release. Action authority always lives outside the Decision Runtime.

DecisionExecutionFacts.title: DecisionExecutionFacts
DecisionExecutionFacts.description: Measured execution facts for the terminal attempt. `configured_compute_units` is reported separately by the provider; execution location and remote-processing flags are honest per-attempt facts, never marketing claims.

provider_id.description: Provider adapter identifier, such as `deterministic_rules` or `laya_coreml`.

profile_id.description: Model profile identifier, or null for the deterministic route.

execution_location.description: Where the assessment actually executed. `remote` is unimplemented in this release.

remote_processing_used.description: Constant false in this release; local-only constraints always win.

provider_forward_passes.description: Model forward passes consumed. Multiple questions mean multiple passes; this is counted separately from user requests.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens consumed, if the provider reports them.

DecisionRecordStatus.title: DecisionRecordStatus
DecisionRecordStatus.description: Terminal and non-terminal lifecycle states of one evaluation record. Abstention and failure are normal product outcomes, not errors of the envelope.

DecisionRecord.title: DecisionRecord
DecisionRecord.description: The durable record of one evaluation. Every terminal record identifies the evaluation, the effective context it ran under, the exact definition/subject/source revisions, provider and preparation identities, the typed prediction, the deterministic disposition and the execution facts. Abstention, cancellation and failure are first-class terminal states with their own reason codes.

DecisionRecordGetInput.title: DecisionRecordGetInput
DecisionRecordGetInput.description: Input for `decision.record.get`. Authorisation is re-checked against the caller's current grant; idempotent replay of a record is not a permission bypass.

evaluation_id.description: Identifier — Generic bounded, non-empty identifier used for clients, principals, roles, and deprecations.

DecisionRecordListInput.title: DecisionRecordListInput
DecisionRecordListInput.description: Input for `decision.record.list`: the caller's authorised evaluation records for the selected workspace, newest first.

limit.description: Bounded maximum number of records to return in this page.

page.description: Pagination position; an absent page asks for the first page.

DecisionRecordListResult.title: DecisionRecordListResult
DecisionRecordListResult.description: One page of authorised evaluation records.

records.description: DecisionRecord — The durable record of one evaluation. Every terminal record identifies the evaluation, the effective context it ran under, the exact definition/subject/source revisions, provider and preparation identities, the typed prediction, the deterministic disposition and the execution facts. Abstention, cancellation and failure are first-class terminal states with their own reason codes.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when the list is exhausted.

DecisionOption.title: DecisionOption
DecisionOption.description: One declared option of a choice definition: a stable identifier, a human label and a bounded description. Options are an ordered list; the order is part of the definition's identity and digest. One-option decisions are ill-formed - a constant belongs in deterministic code.

id.description: Stable option identifier used in predictions.

description.description: Bounded description given to the model alongside the label.

DecisionDefinitionSummary.title: DecisionDefinitionSummary
DecisionDefinitionSummary.description: One permitted definition version as `decision.definition.list` and `decision.definition.get` report it.

id.description: Identifier — Generic bounded, non-empty identifier used for clients, principals, roles, and deprecations.

purpose.description: What this definition assesses and for whom.

enabled.description: Whether this version currently admits evaluations.

digest.description: Opaque definition digest binding question, rubric, options, recipe and model settings.

DecisionDefinitionListInput.title: DecisionDefinitionListInput
DecisionDefinitionListInput.description: Input for `decision.definition.list`: permitted definition versions for the selected workspace.

include_disabled.description: Whether disabled versions appear in the list.

definitions.description: DecisionDefinitionSummary — One permitted definition version as `decision.definition.list` and `decision.definition.get` report it.

definition_ref.description: DecisionDefinitionRef — An immutable Decision Definition version. Definitions are immutable; a semantic change to question, rubric, options or recipe is a new version.

DecisionDefinitionPublishInput.title: DecisionDefinitionPublishInput
DecisionDefinitionPublishInput.description: Input for `decision.definition.publish`: one new immutable definition version. The document is structured data only - identifiers, bounded text, ordered options and recipe references. Executable content of any kind is not a valid field, and a semantic change to any meaning-bearing part requires a new version and qualification review.

definition.description: The immutable definition document: stable id, semantic version, title, purpose, owning product, author provenance, decision kind, ordered options or rubric, instructions, required evidence fields, context recipe version, supported languages, minimum source freshness, risk floor, permitted output uses, privacy floor and approved candidate profile identifiers. Bounded to the definition schema; a digest is computed by the service.

DecisionDefinitionDisableInput.title: DecisionDefinitionDisableInput
DecisionDefinitionDisableInput.description: Input for `decision.definition.disable`: stop one version admitting evaluations. Records and history are unaffected.

definition_ref.description: DecisionDefinitionRef — An immutable Decision Definition version. Definitions are immutable; a semantic change to question, rubric, options or recipe is a new version.

DecisionOutcomeSubmitInput.title: DecisionOutcomeSubmitInput
DecisionOutcomeSubmitInput.description: Input for `decision.outcome.submit`: append one evidenced outcome or correction to an evaluation. The original prediction is preserved, never overwritten. An actor preference is not automatically ground truth; outcome provenance records who submitted it and on what evidence.

evaluation_id.description: Identifier — Generic bounded, non-empty identifier used for clients, principals, roles, and deprecations.

outcome.description: The reviewer's or system's evidenced conclusion about the assessment.

corrected_option_id.description: For corrected choice/ordinal outcomes: the evidenced correct option.

evidence_refs.description: Opaque evidence references supporting the outcome.

DecisionModelProfileSummary.title: DecisionModelProfileSummary
DecisionModelProfileSummary.description: One approved model profile as `decision.model.list` reports it, with the five lifecycle dimensions kept separate (installation, activation, health, qualification, processing). A model being installed or ready says nothing about task qualification.

installed_size_bytes.description: Complete on-disk bundle size when installed.

compute_configuration.description: Configured compute units, reported separately from observed execution evidence.

DecisionModelListInput.title: DecisionModelListInput
DecisionModelListInput.description: Input for `decision.model.list`: approved profiles and their current state. Passive; never triggers downloads or loading.

include_unqualified.description: Whether profiles without task qualification appear in the list. Absent defaults to true: unvalidated profiles are shown as advisory.

DecisionModelListResult.title: DecisionModelListResult
DecisionModelListResult.description: Approved model profiles and their lifecycle state.

profiles.description: DecisionModelProfileSummary — One approved model profile as `decision.model.list` reports it, with the five lifecycle dimensions kept separate (installation, activation, health, qualification, processing). A model being installed or ready says nothing about task qualification.

DecisionModelActionInput.title: DecisionModelActionInput
DecisionModelActionInput.description: Input for `decision.model.install`, `decision.model.activate` and `decision.model.remove`: one approved profile identifier. Profile identifiers must come from the signed catalogue; the page and the CLI cannot select arbitrary model files or repositories.

DecisionStatusResult.title: DecisionStatusResult
DecisionStatusResult.description: Passive status projection for `decision.status`: engine availability on the selected host, processing state and the caller's applicable grants. Reading it never downloads, warms, starts Core or processes records.

schema_version.description: DecisionSchemaVersion — The payload schema version for every decision payload in this boundary. Independent of the application envelope and workspace format versions.

host_engine_available.description: Whether any local provider can run on the selected Core host. False on unsupported hosts, truthfully, regardless of client hardware.

host_support_reason.description: Bounded explanation when unavailable, such as an unsupported host class.

enabled.description: Whether Local Decisions processing is currently enabled.

DecisionSettings.title: DecisionSettings
DecisionSettings.description: Applicable Local Decisions configuration as `decision.settings.get` reports it: processing state, subscription state and bounded budgets. Defaults are the specification's conservative set; disabling never deletes history.

schema_version.description: DecisionSchemaVersion — The payload schema version for every decision payload in this boundary. Independent of the application envelope and workspace format versions.

subscription_enabled.description: Whether the bounded new-document classification subscription admits work.

subscription_daily_budget.description: Daily provider forward-pass ceiling for the subscription.

include_defaults.description: Whether unset values are reported with the specification's conservative defaults. Absent defaults to false: unset values are omitted.

DecisionSettingsUpdateInput.title: DecisionSettingsUpdateInput
DecisionSettingsUpdateInput.description: Input for `decision.settings.update`: compare-and-swap configuration change. The revision must match the caller's last observed value; a mismatch is a conflict, and the update cannot enable processing the caller has no grant for.

revision.description: The configuration revision the caller last observed.

subscription_daily_budget.description: New daily ceiling, bounded by installation policy.

DecisionDefinitionPublishResult.description: Result for `decision.definition.publish`: the immutable version now registered, with its computed digest. Publication binds contract metadata; it does not enable evaluations or grant any caller.

DecisionOutcomeSubmitResult.title: DecisionOutcomeSubmitResult

DecisionInputBundle.title: DecisionInputBundle
DecisionInputBundle.description: Authorised evidence inputs for one evaluation. Source references are resolved and access-checked by the runtime after admission; inline state is caller-supplied evidence, never verified organisational truth, and is preserved as such in the record.

source_refs.description: Opaque authorised source references, resolved against the caller's effective grant.

inline_state.description: Optional caller-supplied structured state, data-only and bounded. It is never executed and never treated as verified fact.

DecisionEvaluateResult.description: Admission result for `decision.evaluate`: the durable evaluation identity and its job reference. A bounded caller wait may return the terminal record via `decision.record.get`; a cold start returns pending status without holding the transport.
